### [`unused_e3e8`](../../../../src/leftovers/leftover_e3e8.asm#L6) `$E3E8-$E3FF`

*data*

24 bytes after the 1000 screen bytes of the stored arena. They are the same bytes as $47e8-$47ff: the stored screen is a copy of all 1 KB at $4400. Nothing reads them.
